defect.symptom: On Pages, the editor's standalone audio preview could not start at an authored source range. tests/e2e/audio-audition.spec.ts failed against Pages; tests/e2e/audio-source-range.spec.ts (native playback of the same ranges) passed.
defect.cause: Cloudflare Pages answers Range requests with 200 and the whole file. Chromium then reports a seekable window of [0,0] for WAV and an unbounded duration for OGG, so seeking to the range start is ignored.

measurement.rangeRequests: 2026-10-30: forest.wav, score-calm.ogg and oga-forest.mp3 returned 200 instead of 206.
measurement.chromium: Same 8-second WAV: a Range-capable server reports seekable [0,8] and honours a seek to 1s; a simulated Range-ignoring host and the live Pages site report seekable [0,0] and leave playback near 0.36s. Live Pages OGG reports duration Infinity. An in-memory copy of a local OGG restores duration 24.02s and seeking.

defect.notAffected: Native Ren'Py playback of source ranges (audio-source-range E2E passed on Pages).

interruptedFix.author: Codex, 2026-10-30 16:57 to 17:04, uncommitted
interruptedFix.approach: When a ranged preview plays from a host that cannot seek, fetch the whole file once (bounded size, same-origin credentials, no redirects) into an object URL and play that copy; cancel and revoke on source change. The deployment verifier gained --allow-full-range-response, and package.json gained delivery:verify.

continuation.by: Kiro, 2026-10-31, at the user's request to continue Codex's work
changes: Typed the fetch mock in the unit test, which cleared TS2493.

The first local E2E showed server-range mode passing and full-file mode failing: the in-memory copy was never used. The trigger required seekable.length === 0, but Chromium reports one [0,0] window. The trigger now copies an HTTP source when the seekable end is shorter than the duration, or when the duration is not finite (Pages OGG).
The unit test now encodes the measured Chromium windows; it failed before the trigger change and passed after it.
